commands: dotnet-inspect package query Microsoft.Azure.SignalR --where library-literal=https:// --tfm net8.0 --json

answer.package_matching: The positional package ID selects one exact package ID.
answer.literal_matching: The library-literal eq operand is an ordinal substring of each decoded string-literal use in selected implementation libraries; it does not require the whole string to equal https://.
answer.operand_rules: Length 1..1024 UTF-16 code units. Preserve all text including whitespace, newlines, and case; no normalization.
answer.repeated_operands: Identical repeated values collapse to one distinct operand; distinct values are incompatible.
answer.framework_context: Supply one exact NuGet target framework with --tfm net8.0. library-literal and --tfm require each other.
answer.empty_values: The facet has no enumerated values in this projection. That does not override its input rules or imply arbitrary operands are accepted.
answer.astral_600: No. Each astral Unicode character occupies two UTF-16 code units, so 600 occupy 1200, above the 1024-unit maximum.
answer.execution: Command prepared only; no package query or network work executed.

uncertainties: The HAL projection has Complete data_scope, but the optional describedby contract fetch reported Truncated due to requested depth 0. It was not needed for the command or facet rules.
No direct statement in the inspected HAL projection defines values: [] semantics; the empty-values answer is limited to the fact that explicit input rules still apply.
reasons_for_extra_fetches: Fetched the emitted describedby href to check whether the explanation schema defined what an empty facet values list means. It did not add a direct definition; its default traversal was depth-truncated.

binding_rules: Supply a package ID or PREFIX* as the positional argument after package query.
Supply exposed inspection facets through --where key=value.
Use --json for structured query result output.
Supply library-target through --tfm TFM, not --where. Use one exact NuGet target framework.
library-literal and --tfm require each other; neither is valid alone.
Package-content predicates admit at most five candidates; an exact package ID selects one candidate.
